title: Dan Quinn tells Jayden Daniels to "take your shot" even then there's a penalty flag on the field

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Quinn tells Jayden Daniels to "take your shot" even then there's a penalty flag on the field
sources.description: One of the lingering questions from this week's Monday Night Football relates to the perception that Commanders coach Dan Quinn didn't know his team was facing a fourth-and-two play from the San Francisco 13 when it was, you know, facing a fourth-and-two play from the San Francisco 13.
